scope: gateway conservative accounting; not provider invoice

counter_semantics.requests: Gateway-admitted durable reservations before pacing/count HTTP/inference; not a verified upstream send count.
counter_semantics.count_requests: Incremented at reservation, not proof each count HTTP request was sent.
counter_semantics.completed: Provider completion/usage events verified and settled by the gateway.
counter_semantics.errors: Failed or uncertain reservation outcomes, not necessarily upstream HTTP failures.
counter_semantics.input_tokens_and_output_tokens: Verified completed-response usage only; failed upstream consumption can remain unknown.
counter_semantics.maximum_charged_usd: Conservative committed+retained+reserved ceiling; not provider invoice or actual spent dollars.
counter_semantics.no_refund_or_settlement_performed: This final read-only inspection performed no settlement/refund; normal request settlement occurred earlier during the run.
